comment: Honestly the worst professor I have ever had in my 22 years of living. She reads STRAIGHT from the powerpoints, and everything in the powerpoints comes straight out of the book. She also gives you handouts to summarize the reading=no incentive to read. Sounds wonderful but to top it off she's painfully boring. It's awful.

You can learn a lot in hickman's class if you actually do the readings. she asks very broad questions in class that force you to think for yourself. its not about having a single right answer but about your ability to analyze material in a logical fashion. i highly recommend.

One of the dumbest people - let alone profs - I've ever met.  An embarrassment to Jepson and UR in general. so ignorant, stupid & slow (yet a hard grader - unfair!).  COMPLETELY unhelpful, contradicted herself, unclear on assignment guidelines, unwilling to help outside class, didnt even learn our names by the end of the semester in class of 8 kids
Her class was easy, but not easy enough to make up for how incredibly boring she is. I can't even begin to describe...Her class made me want to stab my eyes out with a pencil.

The nicest, sweetest woman ever who is really knowlegdeable about Leadership Studies. A little spacy though and not that engaging as a lecturer but you really learn a lot. Tests are hard if you don't know the material but otherwise the only trouble you will have is finishing in the time given. Definitly take one of her classes before you graduate!

She is a nice and fascinating professor and her class is very worthwhile. The readings are interesting and the disccussions that she leads are very worthwhile. There is out of class requirements which take some time but are not overwhelming. Take a class with her - it is a must!

I learned nothing, except I didnt want to take more leadership classes. Neither she nor the subject matter were interesting or enlightening. Didnt get a good grade, despite working, but most ppl seemed to think she was easy. Prob just a fluke in my case. Or Im just dumb :)

BORING!!!  I can't count how many times I fell asleep in her class.  Her tests are easy, but it's not worth it.  Her assignments are ambiguous and she never even takes the time to learn anyone's name.  Save yourself the pain and skip her class.
Boring as could be.  Repetative, easy, but might want to make you kill yourself because shes SOOO incredibly boringgggg.  Shes a leadership studies pioneer, but my god shes s o o o boring.
the worst class of my life!  she teaches like we're 5. easy but aweful!  unchallenging, uninteresting.  a total waste of time.  I've learned nothing - except that Hickman is the worst teacher ever.
